title: NekoNameTags
description: NekoNameTags is a cross-platform mod that adds customizable, animated name tags and status displays across games and social platforms like Resonite, ChilloutVR, and Minecraft.
body:
NekoNameTags

NekoNameTags is a cross-platform name tag system designed to enhance how player information is displayed in multiplayer environments.
It allows players and communities to display customizable name tags, statuses, and dynamic information above characters in supported games and social platforms.

The goal of NekoNameTags is to create a consistent and flexible name tag experience across multiple platforms, allowing communities to share identity, roles, and live information in a clear and visually appealing way.

Features

Customizable Name Tags
Display styled player names with colors, formatting, and additional information.

Multi-Line Information Display
Show extra details such as roles, supporter status, community ranks, or activity indicators.

Cross-Platform Support
Designed to work across multiple environments including:

Resonite

ChilloutVR

Minecraft

Additional platforms planned for future releases.

Dynamic Information
Name tags can display live data such as status indicators, streaming activity, or other supported integrations.

Community Integration
Useful for communities, servers, and creators who want a consistent identity system across different platforms.

Use Cases

NekoNameTags can be used for:

Community ranks and roles

Streamer indicators or activity status

Server staff tags

Player customization and identity

Events and community recognition systems

Future Plans

The project is actively being developed with plans to support additional platforms and expand customization options.

Future updates may include:

Additional platform integrations

Expanded customization features

Improved synchronization across supported environments

Compatibility

Current supported environments:

Resonite

ChilloutVR

Minecraft

More platforms will be added as development continues.
